sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Price adjustment from 01 November 2026 – HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and your continued partnership. Your letter doc:20260911-70110-P01 asks for a 9.5% increase to €138.55 from 2026-11-01. However, our contract ctr:4600070110 runs until 2026-12-31. We can offer three packages: (A) €129.53 from 2027-01-01 with 60 days payment; (B) €132.00 from 2026-11-01 with 60 days; (C) €135.00 from 2026-11-01 with 30 days. Could you provide a cost breakdown and confirm? We value our long-standing cooperation.

Viele Grüße,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Furthermore, we acknowledge your reference to the contract duration and appreciate your flexibility in proposing an implementation on 1 November 2026.

As a family-owned foundry, we do not share internal cost breakdowns, but assure you our pricing strictly reflects the verified increases in our expenses. LCI-C, PPI-C241, and PPI-D351 are our main cost drivers.

Building on your third package, we can offer €135.80 per unit from 1 November 2026 with 30 days payment to conclude this agreement. Specifically, our offer is a price of €135.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Brandlhuber price adjustment for part:310010
move.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer offer:70110-1 at €135.80 with 30 days payment. We appreciate your movement. However, our contract ctr:4600070110 runs until 2026-12-31, so your requested effective date doc:20260911-70110-P01 of 2026-11-01 is premature. To support your cost pressures, we propose three packages: (A) €134.50 from 2026-11-01 with 60 days payment; (B) €133.50 from 2027-01-01 with 60 days; (C) €135.00 from 2026-11-01 with 30 days. We believe these reflect a fair balance. Please confirm which package you can accept.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Furthermore, we have already taken that notice period data into account. 

We appreciate your continued dialogue and the packages you have proposed. However, as the points you raised do not introduce new factors, we have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We must maintain our previous offer. We stand by our price of €135.80 per unit with 30 days payment from 1 November 2026, which accurately reflects our verified cost increases. 

Under our Angebot, our price is €135.80 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
